resources.string: Log your first workout and Buddy will start suggesting weights, rest days and deloads.
You\'re on track. Keep logging and Buddy will tell you when something needs attention.
It\'s been %1$d days since your last workout. A lighter session today gets you back into rhythm.
%1$s has stalled. Try a deload this week: %2$s × %3$d.
This week %1$s got %2$d sets, over 30%% more than last week. Watch out for overload.
%1$d weeks in a row on target. Keep it up!
Buddy AI needs the GymBuddy server, which isn\'t set up in this build yet. Buddy\'s tips on the Workout tab work without it.
Sign in to your GymBuddy account to chat with Buddy. Your account keeps the conversation and your monthly allowance.

To answer, Buddy AI sends a summary of your training to GymBuddy\'s server and to Anthropic\'s Claude: your last 8 weeks of workouts, records, body weight and goal profile. Never your email, name, photos or location. Chats are saved to your account so Buddy remembers them; you can delete them at any time.
I agree, turn on Buddy AI
Buddy is not a doctor or physiotherapist. If something hurts, stop and ask a professional.
What should I train this week?
Why has my progress slowed down?
Am I training too much or too little?
Free plan: 5 messages a month. Pro chats without limits.
You\'ve used this month\'s Buddy AI messages.
No connection. Buddy\'s tips still work offline.
Buddy can\'t help with that one. Try asking about your training.
Buddy couldn\'t answer just now. Try again in a moment.
Your session expired. Sign in again in Settings.
A nudge when you fall behind your weekly goal, and your weekly report on Monday mornings (Pro).
Your goal is %1$d workouts a week. Even a short session today keeps you on track.
Buddy looked back at last week. Open GymBuddy to read it.
With Pro, Buddy AI writes you a report every week: workouts against your goal, volume by muscle group, records, and one clear focus for next week.
The weekly report is written by Buddy AI. Turn it on first: open Buddy, sign in and agree to send your training summary.
Buddy is looking back at last week…
4-week cycles from today: three build weeks, then a lighter deload week. Buddy\'s targets follow it.
It\'s the deload week of your cycle. Every target is about 10% lighter, so you come back stronger next week.
Buddy AI also reads the last 7 days of sleep and steps from Health Connect.
With Pro, Buddy AI designs a routine around your goal, schedule and history, using exercises from your library. You check it before it becomes templates.
Tell Buddy what you want. It uses your goal profile, history and recovery, and only exercises from your library.
For example: 4 days a week, upper/lower, about an hour, no barbell squats
Buddy is putting your routine together…
Saved. You\'ll find it as a folder of templates on the Workout tab.
